purpose: Teach: 魔力/某所/左派/フィラデルフィア/ケルン/チュニジア/灘/時事通信

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、芸術作品の魔力、つまり魔的引力の研究を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Ren — you wrote your paper on the magical power of artworks, didn't you?
lines.style: Warm, affirming tone. Patient pause before the dash, as if inviting him to join the conversation. Steady, observant — the quality of a teacher who remembers details about her students' work.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、某所、つまり匿名地点での歴史的会合の研究を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes — I actually wrote on the history of that anonymous location and the historical gathering that happened there.
lines.style: Slight hesitation, then committed. Small stumble on the clarification, but pressing forward. The carefulness of someone who knows his subject deeply but second-guesses how to say it.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、戦後の左派、つまり左派系思想の動向研究を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Ren — and for another one, you explored postwar left-wing thought and its trajectory, correct?
lines.style: Gently probing, reflective. Not accusatory — genuinely checking what he actually wrote. The thoughtful cadence of a teacher revisiting her notes with a student.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、米国フィラデルフィアの独立宣言の歴史研究を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes — actually, I wrote on the history of the Declaration of Independence in Philadelphia.
lines.style: Quiet correction, not defensive. A small beat of 'you might have missed this one.' Direct and steady, owning the divergence from what was assumed.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、ドイツのケルン大聖堂の建築史を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Ren — and you covered the architectural history of Cologne Cathedral in Germany, didn't you?
lines.style: Reflective, almost musing. The rhythm of someone checking facts but also noticing a pattern. Slightly longer pause before the question mark — giving space for him to respond.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、チュニジア革命の社会学研究を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes — no, that one I wrote on the Tunisian Revolution from a sociological angle.
lines.style: Gentle correction again. A soft catch, not a contradiction. The honesty of someone who keeps having to clarify. Slightly weary but not impatient.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、灘地域、つまり灘の海運の歴史研究を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Ren — you focused on the maritime history of the Nada region, yes?
lines.style: Thoughtful, almost reflective. A longer breath before the question, as if mentally reviewing notes. Steady and patient, genuinely interested in getting the actual answer.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、時事通信社の報道史を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes — actually, I wrote on the journalistic history of Jiji Press.
lines.style: Final correction, calm and definitive. The closing note of someone who has gently but clearly set the record straight. A quiet understatement of certainty — he knows what he wrote.
